Skills.Name: Sword Novice
Skills.Description: Learn the foundations of close sword combat. Unlocks Opening Break and Quick Cut.

Skills.Name: Sword Adept
Skills.Description: Build on novice sword training with committed follow-up strikes. Unlocks Driving Cut and Finishing Cut.

Skills.Name: Bow Novice
Skills.Description: Learn to draw, aim and release a bow. Unlocks Quick Shot and Aimed Shot.
